correctness.rationale: With \(d_k=\int_{\widetilde P}H^{5-k}L^k\) on the common resolution, the source intersections for \(D=5H-2E\) give preliminary values \((1,5,25,45,-15,21)\). The twenty disjoint codimension-three plane blowups have \(N_{\Pi/P^-}\simeq\mathcal O_{\mathbf P^2}(-1)^{\oplus3}\), \(H|_\Pi=l\), and \(D|_\Pi=-l\), so exact pushforward gives total correction \((0,0,0,-20,20,-20)\). The resulting tuple is \((1,5,25,25,5,1)\). The standalone verifier recomputes all arithmetic exactly, and \(d_5=1\) agrees with the source's birationality calculation.

value.rationale: Projective multidegree is a canonical graph invariant of a rational map. For a new quintic Cremona transformation, the middle values are not determined by forward and inverse degree alone. The values \(d_2=d_3=25\) measure the contribution of the twenty residual base planes and give exact comparison and reproducibility data for higher-dimensional Cremona geometry.
